paragraphs.origin: I started my journey into development two years ago with a strong focus on frontend and clean UI. My interest in coding began at a young age and grew further through hands-on experience in a tech-driven work environment.
paragraphs.workStyle: You will often find me debugging, refactoring, and improving projects to make them more robust and maintainable. I work analytically and in a structured way: I break complex tasks into individual steps, dig into topics carefully, and develop solutions that are efficient and well thought out.
paragraphs.drive: What motivates me most is working on meaningful and innovative products, especially in startup environments where ideas turn into real impact. I am open to remote work as well as new opportunities where I can grow and keep learning.
